Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that create a three‑day weekend, either because the holiday falls on a Friday/Monday or because it is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend).  
These dates are based on the federal holidays that apply nationwide; provincial variations (e.g., Family Day dates differ only in the month, not the day of the week) are shown where relevant.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sun) | Mon Jan 2 | **Jan 1 – 3** (Sun‑Tue) | Observed on Monday when it falls on a weekend. |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB) | Feb 20 (Mon) | – | **Feb 18 – 20** (Sat‑Mon) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | – | **Apr 7 – 9** (Fri‑Sun) | Federal holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | – | **May 20 – 22** (Sat‑Mon) | Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) | Mon Jul 3 | **Jul 1 – 3** (Sat‑Mon) | Observed on Monday when it falls on a weekend. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | – | **Sep 2 – 4** (Sat‑Mon) | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | – | **Oct 7 – 9** (Sat‑Mon) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Sat) | Mon Nov 13 | **Nov 11 – 13** (Sat‑Mon) | Observed on Monday when it falls on a weekend. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | – | **Dec 23 – 25** (Sat‑Mon) | Observed on Monday when it falls on a weekend. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tue) | – | – | Not part of a long weekend. |

### Quick Reference (Date Ranges)

- **Jan 1 – 3** (New Year’s Day)
- **Feb 18 – 20** (Family Day)
- **Apr 7 – 9** (Good Friday)
- **May 20 – 22** (Victoria Day)
- **Jul 1 – 3** (Canada Day)
- **Sep 2 – 4** (Labour Day)
- **Oct 7 – 9** (Thanksgiving)
- **Nov 11 – 13** (Remembrance Day)
- **Dec 23 – 25** (Christmas Day)

> **Tip for App Integration**  
> Store each long‑weekend as a start and end date (or as a list of dates) so you can easily query whether a given date falls within a long weekend. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta vs. Manitoba), you can add a `province` field to each entry.

Let me know if you’d like the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need province‑specific long weekends!
